title: Food & drink

grammar.title: Ordering like a local
grammar.body: To order, point and say **para mí ___** (for me ___) or **quiero ___**. Ask **¿qué me recomienda?** for the house pick. **Picante** means spicy — in Mexico, always ask **¿con o sin chile?** Street tacos are ordered by the piece; **para llevar** = to go.

canDo: Say with/without something and handle spice
Ask for a recommendation and the check

items.note: 'agua fresca' = fruit water; 'sin hielo' = no ice.

comprehension.english: Do you want them with or without chili?
comprehension.question: What are they asking?
